'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Josh Mack DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
